primitives.name: Product Measure Construction
primitives.verbatim_quote: If, for every measurable set E in X × Y, then λ is a finite measure on S × T with the property that λ(A × Y) = μ(A) and λ(X × B) = ν(B), whenever A ε S and B ε T.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'X': 'measurable space, dimensionless', 'Y': 'measurable space, dimensionless', 'μ': 'finite measure on X, unitless', 'ν': 'finite measure on Y, unitless', 'λ': 'product measure on X×Y, unitless'}
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E ⊂ X×Y fails measurability due to uncountable sections.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphism between product sigma-algebra and joint probability structure in GSI; enables joint inference across dimensions.
layer2.telemetry: Verification via measure preservation λ(A×Y)=μ(A) and λ(X×B)=ν(B)

primitives.name: Fubini-Type Integration
primitives.verbatim_quote: If v(B) = fvx(B)dμ(x), if g is a non negative measurable function on Y, and if f(x) = ∫g(y)dv(y), thenf is a non negative measurable function on X and ∫fdμ = ∫gdv.
primitives.latex: \int_X \left(\int_Y g(y) dv(y)\right) d\mu(x) = \int_Y \left(\int_X f(x) d\mu(x)\right) dv(y)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'f(x)': 'measurable function on X, unitless', 'g(y)': 'measurable function on Y, unitless', 'v(B)': 'measure of B under v, unitless', 'μ(x)': 'measure on X, unitless', 'ν(y)': 'measure on Y, unitless'}
primitives.assumptions: Measurable functions and finite measures on product space.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure when integrand lacks joint measurability or measure completeness.

layer2.mapping: Kernel for cross-dimensional integration in GSE; supports recursive conditional expectation computation.
layer2.telemetry: Equality of iterated integrals as verification metric.

primitives.name: Measurable Function Family
primitives.verbatim_quote: Suppose that to almost every x in X there corresponds a finite measure vz on T so that if φ(x) = vz(B), then, for each measurable subset B of Y, φ is a measurable function on X.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'φ(x)': 'measurable function on X, unitless', 'vz(B)': 'measure of B under vz, unitless', 'B': 'measurable subset of Y, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Almost every x ∈ X admits a corresponding finite measure vz on T.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When φ fails to be measurable due to pathological measure dependence.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic representation of parametric families in GSI; enables probabilistic modeling of conditional structures.
layer2.telemetry: Measurability of φ(x) under μ-a.e. x as validation criterion.
